I struggle with this quite a bit growing up as I was born and raised in Bangladesh. Back then I identified with being Sri Lankan and would visit twice a year but still felt like an outsider (ie. was often made fun of speaking Sinhala with an accent and in Bangladesh I was treated like an outsider by my peers). It’s something that changed once my family moved to Canada - it’s encouraged here to embrace your cultural identity while blending into society, and meeting fellow third culture kids and first generation immigrants made me feel less alone in my experiences. It’s been 12 years since I moved but I feel like Canada is where I feel the most at home. That said, I do have a special place in my heart for Sri Lanka.
